notes.title: Major patch update for the 1bit Competition
notes.content:
Roskis big patch update!

For 1Bit Competition, we released a brand new patch for Roskis which replaced various known bugs and glitches with new ones to improve replayability. Can you find them all?

When you think of what one would need to save a planet, there are two things that go without saying : friends and pizza! Thus, we gathered our gang and joined the 1Bit Competition where we showed Roskis to our amazing fellow developers and got to play some of their brilliant games! 

The hosts of the event were kind enough to provide us with plenty of pizza that we all happily munched on - except Pizapple who suddenly went a bit grumpy for some reason. 

Looking forward to future events where we can spread the wisdom of Bingy and take advantage of free food.

notes.title: Support the team by getting your own copy of the amazing Roskis soundtrack!
notes.content:
Since the game is FREE you can support the team now by buying the amazing Roskis soundtrack by Brancosaurus straight on Steam.

Showing your love means a world to us!

notes.title: Roskis: A Boozy Beginning has released!
notes.content: Thank you for your support along the way. Enjoy, spread the word and leave a review!
